findings.responsibility_or_impact: no node owns "the draft is well formed"; the review loop is not a malformed-output filter and was never asked to be one

findings.responsibility_or_impact: the base this lock describes has never produced a scored contextual-ASR number

findings.responsibility_or_impact: the edge set of section 4 is base-level, but only one carrier can declare a level on any edge; the policy id would have to be renamed the moment a second carrier adopts one
findings.summary: The node-context policy is carrier-independent in its machinery and **SLURP-bound in its content**: `SLURP_BOUNDARY_IDS`, `SLURP_BOUNDARY_TEMPLATES` and `PARSER_IDS` are SLURP parsers and SLURP templates, and the registered policy id is literally `typed-slurp-node-context-v1`. findings.responsibility_or_impact: the owner ruling of 2026-09-08 ("revise needs new information + constrained edits + core answer authority") is unimplemented at edges E14/E15/E16 on every carrier
findings.summary: On a `REVISE` the Solver receives the finding, the Planner's token and its own previous draft, and is given **no diff, no statement of what was objected to, and no constraint on what may change**. The revise instruction differs from the first visit by 11 characters, all of them the limits JSON

findings.responsibility_or_impact: AC-2 `relisten` and RE-4 `call_tool` cannot be composed on the one carrier whose task most needs them
findings.summary: The on-demand live speech tool accepts only `full-utterance` ASR and caps its hash-pinned raw source at **30 seconds**, while the proven contextual-ASR unit is a **90-second** window; it has no current-window or span binding with exact audio and frame custody

findings.responsibility_or_impact: Stage 3 cannot consume Audio2Tool outcomes at all, and can consume contextual-ASR outcomes only as a single scalar — not the separate PERSON / WER / non-entity / numeric / insertion vector the owner's own reporting rule requires
findings.summary: The reward/feedback plane is carrier-incomplete. `rails.reward_links._NATIVE_PROJECTIONS` registers projections for `asr-wer`, `asr-wer-whisper` and the three SLURP scorers, and **none for Audio2Tool**; `rails.group_relative_feedback._native_quality` returns the full SLURP sufficient statistics but collapses the whole contextual-ASR carrier to `{"negative_wer": -wer}`

findings.responsibility_or_impact: a cross-task lock cannot cite "the carrier's verdicts" by one rule, and `results_ledger_check` cross-check C already reports rows it cannot pair
findings.summary: Verdict records are placed asymmetrically: SLURP verdicts live in `docs/results/`, while the contextual-ASR and Audio2Tool verdicts live in `docs/readiness/` (`docs/results/` holds one E21 file and no E22 file at all)

findings.responsibility_or_impact: (v1 finding I-4, still reproducing) the episode switch class is the class the lock's Tier B uses to say what a carrier may arm; its own allowlist is described wrongly in three places
findings.summary: `EPISODE_LEVEL_SWITCH_KEYS` holds **seven** members; its own docstring says *"All three are dotted paths … admitting a fourth is a code change"*, and `is_episode_null_arm`'s docstring repeats *"the three today"* before enumerating six. The program spec repeats the staleness ("the fourth and last", "the FIFTH and last")

findings.responsibility_or_impact: (v1 finding I-5, still reproducing) the lock will be read by whoever implements a second carrier's policy, and the comment tells them the wrong thing
findings.summary: `NativeEpisodeConfig.context_policy_json`'s field comment says an absent key, the literal `"raw"` and an all-raw object are "ONE thing here — `None`". The loader assigns the field for **any** declared `context_policy`, including an all-raw one — deliberately, so a declared all-raw arm emits `level: "raw"` receipt rows. The behaviour is right; two docstrings describe the opposite

findings.responsibility_or_impact: KN-4 `materialize` has three config shapes; a Stage-3 optimiser told only about `phase_supply` would search a third of the supply surface
findings.summary: There are **three** supply channels — `phase_supply`, `candidate_supply`, `context_supply` — and no document names all three. `context_supply` exists for exactly one carrier (contextual ASR), requires a later supplied phase and the source-scoped provider, and has never flown
